description: This file defines the ReplyTarget interface, which models an outbound reply target in a Ditto connectivity context. It includes methods for retrieving target address, header mappings, expected response types, and conversion to/from JSON. It also contains nested classes and builder interfaces for constructing instances and identifying JSON fields.

classes.name: ReplyTarget
classes.description: A target to handle outbound Ditto command responses to commands sent by a source or reply-source.

classes.name: ReplyTarget.Builder
classes.description: Builder interface for constructing ReplyTarget instances.

classes.name: ReplyTarget.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains definitions of the JSON fields used in the ReplyTarget JSON representation.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the address for the outbound responses.

methods.name: getHeaderMapping
methods.description: Returns the optional header mapping for outbound message headers.

methods.name: getExpectedResponseTypes
methods.description: Returns the set of response types that should be published to the reply target.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder initialized with the current object's content.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the object to a JsonObject using default or specified schema version and field selector.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ReplyTarget instance from the provided JSON object.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing a ReplyTarget.
